Kasun Srinath Aththanayaka, Returning Officer, Ninthavur Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Ampara, 11th May, 2026. R. M. H. B. Rathnayaka, Returning Officer, Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Kurunegala, 15th May, 2026. Kengatharan Mugunthan, Returning Officer, Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office, Vavuniya, 20th May, 2026.
